info.name: Shutterstock API Reference audio images API

description.content:
The Shutterstock API provides access to Shutterstock's library of media, as well as information about customers' accounts and the contributors that provide the media. The API enables searching, browsing, licensing, and downloading images, videos, audio tracks, and sound effects. It also supports editorial content, computer vision features, collection management, and OAuth 2.0 authentication.
